question: Which of the following states has the red panda as the state animal?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sikkim.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **little mammal that lives in trees **is the** red panda.**
 
• It can be found in the **woods of India, Nepal, Bhutan, the northern mountains of Myanmar, and southern China.**
 
• It flourishes best in** mixed deciduous and conifer forests** with dense understories of **bamboo** between **2,200 and 4,800 meters.**
 
• In** India**, the **Sikkim, Arunachal Pradesh, Darjeeling, and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal **are home to this elusive species.
 
• It is the **state animal of Sikkim.**
 
• The red panda has the greatest level of legal protection because it is listed as** Endangered on the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species and under Schedule I of the Indian Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.**
 
• Since** 2005, WWF **India has been working to protect this species in the** eastern Himalayas.**
